subtopic: Multi-Head Self-Attention, KV Caching and FlashAttention
question_text: [Deep Learning Architectures (CNN, RNN, Transformers) - Q17] In Transformer inference for autoregressive generation, what is the primary computational benefit of Key-Value (KV) caching?

options.text: It avoids recomputing key and value representations for past prompt tokens, reducing generation complexity per token from O(N^2) to O(N)
It quantizes attention matrices to 4-bit precision in GPU SRAM
It eliminates the need for multi-head projections
It enables bidirectional context during causal decoding

answer_explanation: Without KV caching, generating the N-th token requires re-projecting and recomputing attention across all N-1 prior tokens. KV caching saves previous K and V states in GPU VRAM.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: A. Rationale: Without KV caching, generating the N-th token requires re-projecting and recomputing attention across all N-1 prior tokens. KV caching saves previous K and V states in GPU VRAM.
